title: LifeSpecPlugin
description: all abilitys are used via /spec activate
body:
ALL ABILITYS are going to be used with /spec.

phantom:

Ability: when this player runs /spec they get true invis(without particles) for 1M and his trusted players will get speed 2 and invis(with particles).

onHit: Takes 3 seconds away from the enemies positive potion effects. 

passive: No Fall damage

Cooldown: 2mins and 30secs

riftwalker:

Ability: Allows the player to dash in the direction they are looking (ground is not included).

onKill: they get 10 seconds of spectator mode.

passive: whenever they shoot a bow and crouch they get teleported to where the arrow lands

Cooldown: 45 seconds

guardian: 

Ability: lifts stuff from the ground around the player and uses them to build a sheild around them(non breakable by players) breaks over a course of 5 seconds and will give all trusted players resistance 1 for 30 seconds.

onKill: grants resistance 1 for 1m

passive: when the player has the effect regeneration of any kind they do double the damage.

Cooldown: 1min and 50seconds

berserker:

Ability: grants strength 2 and speed 2 for 30sec.

onHit: for every single hit it adds and extra 10 seconds of strength 2.

passive: when below five hearts they move ten percent faster.

Cooldown: 45secs

revenant:

Ability: there is a circle that spawns in a 10 block radius of the player in each direction and it lowers the players in the circle hearts down to 7 hearts(if lower stays the same also cant effect trusted players) If the player manages to kill someone IN the circle it they get saturation 2)

onKill: will grant the player regen and absorption 1 for 30secs.

passive: they get 3 extra hearts.

Cooldown: 3mins

ALL NOTES:
ALL ABILITYS DONT HURT /TRUSTED PLAYER ALSO ADD THE /TRUST COMMAND THX
